speaker: Unknown
en: Chamath, thanks for joining the Axio Show.
zh: Chamath，感谢加入 Axio 节目。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's great to see you, Dan.
zh: 很高兴见到你，Dan。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you've been in Silicon Valley for about 25 years, and now it's kind of become AI Valley.
zh: 你在硅谷待了大约 25 年，现在这里有点变成了 AI 硅谷。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's the feeling?
zh: 这里的感觉怎么样？

speaker: Unknown
en: What's your feeling here now compared to, say, when you came?
zh: 与你刚来的时候相比，你现在的感觉如何？

speaker: Unknown
en: Gosh, I think I mentioned this last week, but I think it's a bit of the tale of two cities here.
zh: 天哪，我想我上周提到过这一点，但我认为这里有点像是一个双城记。

speaker: Unknown
en: We've always had this cycle of boom and bust.
zh: 我们总是经历这种繁荣与萧条的周期。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, when I first came, it was right before the first dot-com bust.
zh: 你知道，当我第一次来的时候，正好是第一次互联网泡沫破裂之前。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I, like a lot of people at the time, I was a 20-year-old graduate from engineering.
zh: 所以我和当时的许多人一样，是一名 20 岁的工科毕业生。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I wanted to be, you know, on Broadway, so to speak.
zh: 我想成为，你知道，所谓的百老汇明星。

speaker: Unknown
en: And within months of me getting here, it was the top of the market.
zh: 在我来到这里几个月后，市场就达到了顶峰。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we kind of went through the dot-com bust and the rebuild.
zh: 我们经历了互联网泡沫破裂和重建。

speaker: Unknown
en: Went through it again in the mobile wave.
zh: 在移动浪潮中又经历了一次。

speaker: Unknown
en: We had a little burst of it in crypto, but that really didn't amount to much, really.
zh: 我们在加密货币领域有过一点小爆发，但实际上并没有取得太大成果，真的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And now this is the third big cycle.
zh: 现在这是第三个大周期。

speaker: Unknown
en: So in one perspective, sort of what's old is new again.
zh: 所以从某种角度来看，旧事重提了。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, we're going back through this cycle.
zh: 你知道，我们正在经历这个周期。

speaker: Unknown
en: The thing that's different this time around is in these other two cycles, we were very much these like cute, nerdy kids over there in California.
zh: 这次周期不同的是，在前两个周期中，我们非常像是在加州的那些可爱的书呆子小孩。

speaker: Unknown
en: And for the most part, we were both left alone, but generally trusted and generally pretty reasonably well-liked.
zh: 在很大程度上，我们既被放任自流，又被普遍信任，而且通常相当受人喜爱。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when we would always venture out of Silicon Valley, people were like, oh, look at these guys.
zh: 当我们总是走出硅谷时，人们会说，哦，看看这些人。

speaker: Unknown
en: They were like exotic animals at the zoo.
zh: 他们就像动物园里的珍奇动物。

speaker: Unknown
en: And unfortunately, what's happened, I think, in this cycle is that there's...
zh: 不幸的是，我认为在这个周期中发生的事情是……

speaker: Unknown
en: A good amount of admiration, but there's equal parts, I think, where people are frustrated.
zh: 有大量的钦佩，但也有同样多的部分，我认为是人们感到沮丧。

speaker: Unknown
en: They don't trust this community anymore.
zh: 他们不再信任这个群体了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Certain people are viewed as pariahs.
zh: 某些人被视为被遗弃者。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think that is hugely problematic considering what this technology is capable of.
zh: 考虑到这项技术的潜力，我认为这是一个巨大的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: which far exceeds what anything we've done in the past.
zh: 这远远超过了我们过去所做的一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is why I mean by we're sort of, it's a tale of two cities.
zh: 所以这就是为什么我的意思是，我们有点像，这是一个双城记。

speaker: Unknown
en: You do find this technology, generally speaking, AI, to be more important, consequential maybe than the past cycles?
zh: 你确实发现这项技术，一般来说，AI，比过去的周期更重要，更具后果吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, I really don't.
zh: 是的，我真的这么认为。

speaker: Unknown
en: I want to be non-hyperbolic about this, but I think it's true what I'm about to say, which is it's the most important economic leveler
zh: 我想对此保持一种非夸张的陈述，但我接下来要说的是真的，即它是我们一生中最重要的经济平衡器

speaker: Unknown
en: of our lifetime.
zh: 我们这一生中。

speaker: Unknown
en: It is the thing that will create the most amount of equality if it's allowed to get to market.
zh: 如果它被允许进入市场，它将创造最大程度平等的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: It is the thing that will allow anybody to follow their dreams and to build something, to build a life for themselves, to build a life for their family outside of the conventions of what society says has to happen to make a living.
zh: 它将允许任何人追随他们的梦想，去建造一些东西，为自己建立生活，为他们的家庭建立生活，而不受社会所说的为了谋生必须发生的事情的惯例束缚。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why is that?
zh: 为什么是这样？

speaker: Unknown
en: we are at a point where, you know, kind of this old adage where like you stand on the shoulders of giants, right?
zh: 我们到了这样一个地步，你知道，就像这句老话说的那样，你站在巨人的肩膀上，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: Or you stand on the shoulders of all these people that have come before you.
zh: 或者你站在所有来到你之前的人的肩膀上。

speaker: Unknown
en: Think of what has had to happen for AI to happen.
zh: 想想为了 AI 的发生，必须发生什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: And what is AI?
zh: 什么是 AI？

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, you build the internet, then you build the first generation of companies, right?
zh: 好吧，你构建了互联网，然后你构建了第一代公司，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: They make computers.
zh: 他们制造计算机。

speaker: Unknown
en: They make mostly janky software.
zh: 他们主要制造劣质软件。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's kind of okay.
zh: 还可以。

speaker: Unknown
en: We kind of figure out how to string them all together.
zh: 我们弄清楚了如何把它们串联起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: We, you know, Andreessen builds a browser.
zh: 你知道，Andreessen 构建了一个浏览器。

speaker: Unknown
en: We now start to graphically navigate around the world.
zh: 我们现在开始在图形上导航世界。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a Cambrian explosion of information.
zh: 信息发生了寒武纪大爆发。

speaker: Unknown
en: Google comes around and says, well, let me actually document all of it.
zh: Google 出现了，说，好吧，让我实际上把所有东西都记录下来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let me make all this knowledge available to people.
zh: 让我把所有这些知识提供给人们。

speaker: Unknown
en: So far, all amazing things, but frankly, precursors to this moment.
zh: 到目前为止，所有这些都是惊人的事情，但坦率地说，是这个时刻的前奏。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you get to this AI thing and it says, hey, Dan, guess what?
zh: 当你接触到这个 AI 事物，它说，嘿，Dan，猜猜是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: I have a pretty cool thing.
zh: 我有一个很酷的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because of all of this stuff, you can view all of it as just training data.
zh: 因为所有这些东西，你可以把所有这些都视为训练数据。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you're like, well, what does that mean?
zh: 然后你会想，好吧，那是什么意思？

speaker: Unknown
en: I can create this thing, this magical thing that will give you entirely all the expertise of all the great experts and thinkers in any domain that have come before you.
zh: 我可以创造这个东西，这个神奇的东西，它会给你所有在你之前出现的任何领域的伟大专家和思想家的全部专业知识。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'll put it in your pocket.
zh: 我会把它放在你的口袋里。

speaker: Unknown
en: And now you can use it to do whatever you want with it.
zh: 现在你可以用它来做任何你想做的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it's not just you.
zh: 但这不仅仅是你。

speaker: Unknown
en: I give it to your daughter.
zh: 我把它给你女儿。

speaker: Unknown
en: I give it to your mom.
zh: 我给你妈妈。

speaker: Unknown
en: I give it to your sister.
zh: 我给你姐姐。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's what I mean by... Why is that different?
zh: 这就是我的意思……为什么这不同？

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, you and I probably both have smartphones in our pockets.
zh: 我的意思是，你和我可能口袋里都有智能手机。

speaker: Unknown
en: If we were having this conversation five years ago, we would have said something similar, right?
zh: 如果我们在五年前进行这次对话，我们会说类似的话，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: We have all the world's knowledge sitting in our pocket.
zh: 我们把世界上所有的知识都装在口袋里。

speaker: Unknown
en: Knowledge is different than expertise and intelligence.
zh: 知识不同于专业知识和智力。

speaker: Unknown
en: Knowledge is being able to go and search for the design of a PN junction.
zh: 知识是能够去搜索 PN 结的设计。

speaker: Unknown
en: You have no idea what that means.
zh: 你不知道那是什么意思。

speaker: Unknown
en: I do not.
zh: 我不知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can Google it, and you'll show it to somebody else.
zh: 你可以谷歌它，然后把它展示给别人。

speaker: Unknown
en: He also doesn't know what it means.
zh: 他也不知道那是什么意思。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, but you were able to get that information.
zh: 是的，但你能够获得那个信息。

speaker: Unknown
en: PN junction is the core structural unit on which we build a transistor.
zh: PN 结是我们构建晶体管的核心结构单元。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, though, what you can say is, design me a transistor.
zh: 不过现在，你可以说，给我设计一个晶体管。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you have a spec that you can now mail to somebody and they can actually tape that out for you and you can get back in the mail an actual functional thing.
zh: 你有一个规格说明书，你现在可以邮寄给某人，他们实际上可以为你把它流片出来，你可以在邮件中收到一个实际能用的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's this level of expertise that you can shape that was not available before.
zh: 正是这种你可以塑造的专业知识水平，以前是不可用的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you're taking knowledge and you're putting it through this process that makes it actionable.
zh: 所以你获取知识，并通过这个使其可付诸行动的过程来处理它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think that's the breakthrough that's so profound.
zh: 我认为这就是如此深刻的突破。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is why it's also so troubling.
zh: 这也是为什么它如此令人不安。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, how did we get in this place where half the people actually think this is a bad thing?
zh: 比如，我们是怎么走到这一步的，居然有一半人认为这是一件坏事？

speaker: Unknown
en: So we'll talk about that.
zh: 所以我们会谈谈这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let me first ask about something you said, which kind of the not even democratization, but this leveling, I think, is the way you refer to it.
zh: 让我先问问你说过的某件事，我觉得这甚至不是民主化，而是这种拉平，我认为是你描述它的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're also seeing at the same time, though.
zh: 不过我们同时也看到。

speaker: Unknown
en: folks who own these companies or at least lead these companies and their larger shareholders, venture capitalists or something you do, there is... Did.
zh: 那些拥有这些公司或者至少领导这些公司的人，以及他们的大股东，风险投资人或者你做的事情，有……做过。

speaker: Unknown
en: Did, did.
zh: 做过，做过。

speaker: Unknown
en: There seems to be definitely a capital inequality that gets formed by this.
zh: 似乎确实会因此形成资本不平等。

speaker: Unknown
en: You talk about leveling.
zh: 你谈论拉平。

speaker: Unknown
en: Is there also not a concern that just insane amounts of wealth, more than we've seen before, are going to get concentrated in an even smaller number of people?
zh: 难道不也担心疯狂的财富，比我们以前见过的更多的财富，会集中在更少的人手里吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: I think if we do it right, the answer to that question will actually be way better than what we want it to be.
zh: 我认为如果我们做对了，这个问题的答案实际上会比我们想要的要好得多。

speaker: Unknown
en: Does anybody want to live in a world where there are individually five humans that win and 8.7 billion minus five who are not winning as much?
zh: 有人想生活在一个只有 5 个人赢，而 87 亿减 5 个人没有赢那么多人的世界里吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Nobody wants that.
zh: 没人想要那个。

speaker: Unknown
en: Including those five people because their lives become absolutely terrible as well.
zh: 包括那 5 个人，因为他们的生活也会变得绝对糟糕。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay?
zh: 好吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: What do we all want?
zh: 我们都想要什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: We all want to live in a place where two things are true.
zh: 我们都想生活在一个两件事成真的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: I decide to pursue something.
zh: 我决定追求某事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nobody gets in my way.
zh: 没人阻碍我。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nobody tells me I can't do it, that the amount of capital that is required to do it gets smaller and smaller and smaller and approaches zero, right?
zh: 没人告诉我不能做，做这件事所需的资本变得越来越小，接近于零，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: And then the second is I live in a society where so many other people are doing those things that are equivalently what that means for me, for them, so that we all appreciate that we're all trying to make something useful for ourselves.
zh: 然后第二点是，我生活在一个社会里，有很多人都在做那些对我来说、对他们来说同等意义的事情，这样我们都明白，我们都试图为自己做些有用的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think everybody wants that.
zh: 我想每个人都想要那个。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you think that's where we're actually heading right now?
zh: 你觉得这就是我们现在正在前往的方向吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not where we are, but it's where we can go.
zh: 这不是我们现在所在的地方，但这是我们能去的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: So meaning, I had this famous meeting.
zh: 意思是，我有过那次著名的会议。

speaker: Unknown
en: I tweeted about this a lot.
zh: 我发了很多推文谈论这件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was me and Zuck and D'Angelo, Adam D'Angelo, our CTO at Facebook.
zh: 那是 Zuck、D'Angelo 和我，还有 Facebook 的 CTO Adam D'Angelo。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we were raising this round in the middle of all this commercial chaos right before the great financial crisis from Microsoft.
zh: 在所有这些商业混乱的中间，就在大金融危机之前，我们正在从微软那里进行这一轮融资。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think we raised like a billion dollars, which now today seems like a pittance, but at the time just seemed like all the money in the world at this crazy valuation.
zh: 我觉得我们筹集了大概十亿美元，这在今天看来似乎只是九牛一毛，但在当时，在这个疯狂的估值下，似乎就像全世界的钱一样。

speaker: Unknown
en: And, uh,
zh: 而且，呃，

speaker: Unknown
en: We had this meeting with Bill Gates, and it was something along the lines of, why do you think you're building a platform?
zh: 我们和 Bill Gates 开了个会，大意是，你为什么认为你在构建一个平台？

speaker: Unknown
en: And I go through this whole song and dance, and he says something to the effect of, you know, that's not a platform.
zh: 我又唱又跳地说了一大通，然后他说的话大概是，你知道的，那不是一个平台。

speaker: Unknown
en: He said it a little bit more colorful.
zh: 他说得稍微更生动一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll sanitize it for your viewers.
zh: 我会为你的观众把它净化一下。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's true.
zh: 是真的。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can say what you want to say.
zh: 你可以说你想说的话。

speaker: Unknown
en: Oh, yeah.
zh: 哦，是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's like, are you fucking stupid?
zh: 就像是，你是不是他妈的蠢？

speaker: Unknown
en: That's not a platform.
zh: 那不是一个平台。

speaker: Unknown
en: A platform is when the economic value that the participants generate greatly exceeds that of the platform maker.
zh: 平台是指参与者产生的经济价值远远超过平台制造者。

speaker: Unknown
en: That is not what this is telling us, basically, that at the time our efforts at Facebook platform were mischaracterized.
zh: 那不是这个告诉我们的，基本上，当时我们在 Facebook 平台上的努力被错误地定性了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Forget about Facebook platform for a second because it wasn't successful.
zh: 先忘掉 Facebook 平台一秒钟，因为它并不成功。

speaker: Unknown
en: But if you take that sentence and you, for example, look at the Google ecosystem, as much money as Google makes, it is undeniably true that the ecosystem that works around and on top of Google, all the advertisers, all the companies selling things, that economic value far exceeds what Google makes.
zh: 但是如果你拿着这句话，比如说，看看 Google 生态系统，不管 Google 赚多少钱，不可否认的是，围绕并在 Google 之上运作的生态系统，所有的广告商，所有卖东西的公司，其经济价值远远超过 Google 赚的钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's what you think will happen here, whether that be OpenAI or Anthropic.
zh: 这就是你认为这里会发生的事情，无论是 OpenAI 还是 Anthropic。

speaker: Unknown
en: You think what's built on top of them will exceed the values there?
zh: 你认为建立在它们之上的东西将超过在那里的价值？

speaker: Unknown
en: It has the potential if we don't fuck it up.
zh: 如果我们不搞砸的话，它有这个潜力。

speaker: Unknown
en: So go back to this.
zh: 所以回到这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is why I think it's so important for everybody to realize we have the ability to put a genius level co-founder beside every single human, man, woman, child, independent of age, creed, country, sexual orientation.
zh: 所以这就是为什么我认为这对每个人来说都很重要，要意识到我们有能力把一个天才级别的联合创始人放到每个人身边，男人、女人、小孩，无论年龄、信仰、国家、性取向如何。

speaker: Unknown
en: All this equality stuff that we've been blathering on about for years is actually finally possible.
zh: 我们多年来喋喋不休谈论的所有这些平等 stuff，实际上终于有可能实现了。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's real equality?
zh: 什么是真正的平等？

speaker: Unknown
en: It's when you are as smart as the smartest human.
zh: 当你像最聪明的人类一样聪明时。

speaker: Unknown
en: You are as capable as the richest human.
zh: 你像最富有的人类一样有能力时。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're as ingenious as the most connected human.
zh: 你像最有关系的人类一样足智多谋时。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's possible today.
zh: 这在今天是有可能的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we should figure out a way to get out of our own way and give that to people.
zh: 所以我们应该想办法不挡自己的路，把那个东西给人们。

speaker: Unknown
en: When you say get out of our own way, what is one thing you would do that you think is currently in the way?
zh: 当你说不挡自己的路时，你觉得目前挡在路上的一件事是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, I think, look, and I've suffered from this, so this is the kettle calling the pot black in some degrees.
zh: 嗯，我觉得，听着，我也深受其害，所以这在某种程度上是五十步笑百步。

speaker: Unknown
en: Part of the reason that Silicon Valley works is that a lot of the people that start here have had some pretty hard scrabble backgrounds, complicated psychological relationships with their parents, typical stuff.
zh: Silicon Valley 运作的部分原因是，这里的很多初创者都有一些相当艰难的背景，与父母有着复杂的心理关系，典型的情况。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't think it's atypical.
zh: 我觉得这并不典型。

speaker: Unknown
en: I thought I was special to have grown up so fucked up.
zh: 我以为我很特别，长得这么 fucked up。

speaker: Unknown
en: Turned out, no.
zh: 结果，不是。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everybody here is fucked up.
zh: 这里的每个人都是 fucked up。

speaker: Unknown
en: Those boundary conditions generally create deep wells of insecurity.
zh: 那些边界条件通常会产生深层的不安全感。

speaker: Unknown
en: For many people, work fills that well.
zh: 对许多人来说，工作填补了那口井。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then they're able to pour themselves into it to such a degree of obsession, they create these incredible things.
zh: 然后他们能够将自己倾注其中到如此程度的痴迷，创造了这些令人难以置信的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's what's driven this place.
zh: 这就是驱动这个地方的动力。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you look at the great outliers here, they all come back to this general common denominator.
zh: 如果你看看这里的伟大的离群者，它们都回归到这个一般公分母。

speaker: Unknown
en: I've struggled with that insecurity in filling it.
zh: 我曾在填补这种不安全感方面挣扎过。

en: So if you think that this is this incredibly powerful tool, who are the rebels?
zh: 所以如果你认为这是一个非常强大的工具，谁是叛军？

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a group of people that are like, you know what?
zh: 有一群人，你知道什么？

en: We want completely distributed compute.

speaker: Unknown
en: We want completely distributed training.
zh: 我们想要完全分布式的训练。

speaker: Unknown
en: We want completely distributed models.
zh: 我们想要完全分布式的模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: We want completely distributed inference.
zh: 我们想要完全分布式的推理。

en: What does that mean?
zh: 这意味着什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: You have a computer.
zh: 你有一台电脑。

en: You install a little bit of software.

en: I have a computer.

speaker: Unknown
en: I install a little bit of software.

en: Everybody in this room does it.

en: And then all of a sudden,

speaker: Unknown
en: We're now part of a shared community that makes sure that there's nobody that can intercede and interject.
zh: 我们现在成了一个共享社区的一部分，确保没有人可以介入和插手。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think that that is unbelievably exciting.
zh: 我认为那是令人难以置信的兴奋。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I suspect that as these, you know, big monolithic solutions continue to get to scale, I would not sleep on the rebel alliance because I think that there's a really compelling philosophical reason to fight for those to be in existence.
zh: 所以我怀疑，随着这些，你知道，大型单体解决方案继续规模化，我不会忽视那些反叛联盟，因为我认为有令人信服的哲学理由去为它们的存在而战。

speaker: Unknown
en: We started this conversation talking about Silicon Valley then versus now.
zh: 我们开始这次对话时谈论了当时的硅谷与现在的硅谷。

speaker: Unknown
en: You come into Silicon Valley.
zh: 你来到硅谷。

speaker: Unknown
en: We've obviously talked a bunch about the White House.
zh: 我们显然已经谈论了很多关于白宫的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm curious, you obviously you came here via Canada.
zh: 我很好奇，你显然你是通过加拿大来到这里的。

speaker: Unknown
en: One of the things of this White House, kind of one of the marks has been a combination of cuts to basic R&D funding and also cuts to legal immigration, illegal immigration also, but also cuts to legal immigration.
zh: 这届白宫的其中一件事，其中一个标志一直是削减基础研发资金与削减合法移民的结合，非法移民也是，但也包括削减合法移民。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you feel we are handicapping ourselves for that when you think of Silicon Valley as this place where all the greatest minds come?
zh: 你觉得我们因此是在自我设限吗，当你把硅谷看作是所有最伟大的头脑聚集的地方时？

speaker: Unknown
en: I think that there's been a lot of abuse in some of these foundational programs.
zh: 我认为这些基础项目中存在很多滥用行为。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think if you're going to set them on its right course, we have to be honest about the abuses.
zh: 我认为如果你要让它回到正轨，我们必须对滥用行为诚实。

speaker: Unknown
en: But if you stipulate the abuses, but let's stipulate them.
zh: 但如果你承认滥用，但让我们承认它们。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not as easy as saying stipulate.
zh: 这不像说承认那么简单。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let me explain to you what's happening.
zh: 让我向你解释一下正在发生什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: I came out on an H-1B visa.
zh: 我是拿着 H-1B 签证出来的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Elon came out on an H-1B visa, okay?
zh: Elon 是拿着 H-1B 签证出来的，好吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: At the time, you got your H-1B visa right away.
zh: 那时候，你立刻就能拿到你的 H-1B 签证。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then there was many that were available.
zh: 而且当时有很多名额。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is in the early 2000s.
zh: 这是在 2000 年代早期。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why?
zh: 为什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Nobody was applying for these things.
zh: 没有人在申请这些东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so who did you have?
zh: 那么你拥有谁呢？

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, forget about me.
zh: 我的意思是，忘了我吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm irrelevant.
zh: 我是不相关的。

speaker: Unknown
en: But you had guys like him that were coming into this country.
zh: 但你拥有像他那样进入这个国家的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: You had these incredible scientists, Urs Holze, that ends up at Google.
zh: 你拥有这些不可思议的科学家，Urs Holze，最后去了 Google。

speaker: Unknown
en: These are giants, okay?
zh: 这些都是巨人，好吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: What's happening now?
zh: 现在发生了什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: For the last 15 or 20 years, what's been happening?
zh: 在过去 15 年或 20 年里，一直发生着什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: you have farms of applications from a handful of companies.
zh: 你拥有来自少数几家公司的申请农场。

speaker: Unknown
en: 20,000 slots open up, 800,000 applications flood in.
zh: 20,000 个名额开放，800,000 份申请涌入。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you can't stipulate abuse because what that means is the odds have become so overwhelming that the next Elon or Urs Holsey was already being shut out of America.
zh: 所以你不能承认滥用，因为这意味着几率已经变得压倒性，下一个 Elon 或 Urs Holsey 已经被拒之美国门外。

speaker: Unknown
en: I sure as shit would never have gotten an H-1B in the way that the program works today.
zh: 我肯定他妈的永远不会以今天的运作方式拿到 H-1B。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I think it's fair to say two things.
zh: 所以我认为可以说两件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: We can stipulate the following two things.
zh: 我们可以承认以下两件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Immigration is really good.
zh: 移民是很好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: we should be attracting the best of the best of the best and they should want to be here.
zh: 我们应该吸引最优秀中的最优秀，他们应该想要来到这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we should also make it fair so that the best of the best of the best who have been getting Heisman for the last five years because a handful of companies in certain countries have abused this system.
zh: 但我们也应该让它变得公平，这样那些最优秀中的最优秀，在过去五年里一直在获得海斯曼奖，因为某些国家的少数几家公司滥用这个系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to stop and tourniquet the bleeding so that you can reestablish trust with the American population at large.
zh: 你需要止血并扎上止血带，这样你才能与美国大众重建信任。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a lot of people that look at me and say, that guy's part of the problem.
zh: 很多人看着我并说，那个人是问题的一部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can see it in the comments on X.
zh: 你可以在 X 上的评论里看到。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm like, wow, me?
zh: 我就像，哇，我吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: But do you think that's partially because of the rhetoric that's come from D.C., come from this?
zh: 但你认为这部分是因为来自 D.C. 的言论，来自这里吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: No, I think that that's been building up for decades because they see the abuses on the ground.
zh: 不，我认为那已经积累了数十年，因为他们看到了地面的滥用。

speaker: Unknown
en: They see the people that show up and they're like, wait a minute, this people is not smarter than me.
zh: 他们看到出现的人，他们就像，等一下，这个并不比我更聪明。

speaker: Unknown
en: All I can see is wage suppression.
zh: 我只能看到工资被压制。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have a responsibility for the people that are here and paying into the system to answer their questions honestly.
zh: 我们有责任对在这里并向系统付费的人诚实回答他们的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can't stipulate and move on to everything.
zh: 你不能对所有事情都规定一下然后继续推进。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can't.
zh: 你不能。

speaker: Unknown
en: Sometimes you got to say, you know what, that was gross abuse.
zh: 有时候你必须得说，你知道吗，那是严重的滥用。

speaker: Unknown
en: How does that apply to the second piece or the other piece, which was the cuts to basic R&D funding and the changes to the way, for example, you now have political appointees deciding a lot of grant money or being the final call instead of peer-reviewed science?
zh: 这如何适用于第二部分或其他部分，也就是削减基础研发资金，以及改变决定拨款的方式，例如，现在由政治任命的人员来决定大量拨款资金或拥有最终决定权，而不是同行评审的科学？

en: I can talk about AI.
zh: 我可以谈谈 AI。

zh: 我可以谈谈投资。

zh: 我不知道。

en: I don't know.
zh: 我不知道。

en: Okay.
zh: 好的。

en: Fair enough.
zh: 说得有理。

en: Can we talk briefly?
zh: 我们能简短地谈谈吗？

en: One of the things that you did, where are we now?
zh: 你做过的其中一件事，我们现在在哪里？

speaker: Unknown
en: Probably five or six years ago, you got very big into SPACs, these special purpose acquisition vehicles, these blank check companies.
zh: 可能在五六年前，你非常热衷于 SPAC，也就是这些特殊目的收购公司，这些空白支票公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: A lot of it didn't go so well for you.
zh: 其中很多事情对你来说进展得不顺利。

speaker: Unknown
en: You got back into it.
zh: 你又重新回到这个领域。

zh: 大约一年前，你发起了一个。

en: I want to make sure I get the name right here.
zh: 我想确保我把名字弄对。

en: The American Exceptionalism Acquisition Corp.
zh: 美国主义收购公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: but you haven't acquired anything yet.
zh: 但你还没有收购任何东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: Are there not exceptional American companies to buy?
zh: 难道没有卓越的美国公司可以买吗？

en: When you acquire a company, there's a multi-month process of diligencing it, going through audits, putting together the right materials, closing a merger agreement, and announcing a deal.
zh: 当你收购一家公司时，有一个长达数月的流程来对它进行尽职调查，通过审计，整理正确的材料，完成合并协议，并宣布交易。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll just leave it at that.
zh: 我就说到这吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: Suggest there's something coming.
zh: 这暗示有什么事情即将到来。

speaker: Unknown
en: How do you think about...
zh: 你怎么思考……

speaker: Unknown
en: But can I go back to these facts?
zh: 但我可以回到这些事实吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Sure.
zh: 当然。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think it's important, like, what did I learn I think is important?
zh: 我认为这很重要，比如，我学到了什么我认为是重要的？

speaker: Unknown
en: Probably the most important thing I learned, which I fought from accepting for a while, was that my incentives were grossly misaligned.
zh: 可能我学到的最重要的事情，我曾有一段时间不愿意接受，那就是我的激励措施严重错位。

speaker: Unknown
en: You pushed me on that a lot.
zh: 你在那方面逼问过我很多。

speaker: Unknown
en: Andrews Ross Sorkin did.
zh: Andrews Ross Sorkin 确实逼问过。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I was too insecure to admit it.
zh: 而我当时太缺乏安全感而不愿承认。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was like, no, this is the game.
zh: 我当时觉得，不，这就是游戏规则。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is how it works.
zh: 这就是运作方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I think you guys were right.
zh: 但我认为你们是对的。

speaker: Unknown
en: My incentives were totally and fundamentally misaligned because I could do a deal and still get paid.
zh: 我的激励措施完全且根本性地错位了，因为我可以做一笔交易并且仍然得到报酬。

speaker: Unknown
en: Even if the deal- I don't think I did bad deals in the way I underwrote them.
zh: 即使这笔交易——我不认为我在承销这些交易的方式上做了糟糕的交易。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I think the stock performance is what the stock performance is.
zh: 但我认为股票表现就是股票表现。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's undeniable.
zh: 这是不可否认的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's very much a mixed bag.
zh: 这是一个非常混杂的局面。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think if you own them all equally, maybe you're almost at breakeven.
zh: 我认为如果你同等地持有它们，也许你几乎是不盈不亏。

speaker: Unknown
en: But that's quite sad considering what the S&P has done.
zh: 但考虑到标普的表现，那相当令人悲哀。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's a complete outlier negatively relative to my performance and everything else I've done.
zh: 相对于我的表现和我做的其他所有事情，这是一个完全的负面异常值。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I got it wrong.
zh: 但我弄错了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I wanted a second bite at the apple.
zh: 所以我想要第二次机会。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I wanted to reset it.
zh: 我想重置它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I wanted to change the fundamental flaw.
zh: 我想改变那个根本性的缺陷。 [[698]】 那是我以前利用过但现在可以修复的缺陷，也就是现在的激励措施是这样设定的，除非这个东西暴涨，否则我什么都赚不到。

speaker: Unknown
en: that I took advantage of before that I could fix now, which is now the incentives are such where I make nothing unless the thing rips.
zh: 我以前可以利用的那些机会我现在可以修复了，现在的激励机制变成了，除非这个东西大获成功，否则我什么都赚不到。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, that's one class of problem.
zh: 现在，那是一类问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: The second class of problem, which I have not fixed yet, must be fixed.
zh: 第二类问题，我还没有解决，必须解决。

speaker: Unknown
en: The capital markets in America have gotten totally sclerotic.
zh: 美国的资本市场已经变得完全僵化。

speaker: Unknown
en: There are a few gatekeepers.
zh: 只有少数几个把关人。

speaker: Unknown
en: They control all the access to the money.
zh: 他们控制着获取资金的所有途径。

speaker: Unknown
en: It used to be the case that companies used to go public much, much sooner in their evolution.
zh: 过去的情况是，公司在其发展演化的过程中会早得多、早得多上市。

speaker: Unknown
en: It used to be the case that analysts would cover those companies.
zh: 过去的情况是，分析师会覆盖这些公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: You think that's because of gatekeepers?
zh: 你认为这是因为把关人吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: You think it's because you've got so much private capital flooding, companies don't have...
zh: 你认为这是因为你有如此多的私人资本涌入，公司不需要……

speaker: Unknown
en: They used to go public because they needed the money.
zh: 它们过去上市是因为它们需要资金。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, you're debating a chicken and egg question.
zh: 嗯，你在辩论一个先有鸡还是先有蛋的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think that if you could go public the way you could have in 1999 and 2000...
zh: 我认为如果你能像 1999 年和 2000 年那样上市……

zh: 在 1976 年，在 1996 年，像 Michael Dell 上市这样的公司，Michael Dell 在 8500 万美元的估值下卖出了 3000 万美元的 Dell 股票，经风险调整后每股 0.09 美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: What that allowed is any man, woman, and child, any man or woman, any American most importantly,
zh: 这使得任何男人、女人和孩子，任何男人或女人，最重要的是任何美国人，

speaker: Unknown
en: to actually access a share of Michael Dell's operating genius.
zh: 都能真正分享到 Michael Dell 的运营才华。

speaker: Unknown
en: You could have done that with Google.
zh: 你本可以对着 Google 这样做。

speaker: Unknown
en: You could have done that with Zuckerberg and Facebook.
zh: 你本可以对着 Zuckerberg 和 Facebook 这样做。

speaker: Unknown
en: Today, when these companies come out, they're so mature that there is a small group of winners and then there's everybody else.
zh: 而今天，当这些公司出来时，它们已经非常成熟，以至于有一小群赢家，然后就是其他所有人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think that is sclerotic.
zh: 我认为这是僵化的。

speaker: Unknown
en: That should not be the case.
zh: 情况本不该如此。

speaker: Unknown
en: We should incentivize companies to go public sooner, to give them risk capital.
zh: 我们应该激励公司尽早上市，给予它们风险资本。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think if you don't do it,
zh: 而我认为如果你不这样做，

speaker: Unknown
en: you're going to have what you have now, which is a further and further concentration of wealth, which clearly pisses everybody off.
zh: 你将得到你现在拥有的东西，即财富的进一步和进一步的集中，这显然让所有人都很恼火。

speaker: Unknown
en: It doesn't benefit anybody.
zh: 这对任何人都没有好处。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I want to break it.
zh: 所以我想打破它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And yes, there is an oligopoly of four banks.
zh: 是的，存在一个四家银行的寡头垄断。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can see it on the masthead of every IPO.
zh: 你可以在每次 IPO 的报头看到它。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we should fix it because it's the right thing to do.
zh: 所以我们应该修复它，因为这是正确的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: You should have a bevy of options.
zh: 你应该有一大批选择。

speaker: Unknown
en: You should direct list if that's what you want.
zh: 如果那是你想要的，你应该直接上市。

speaker: Unknown
en: People have tried.
zh: 人们尝试过。

speaker: Unknown
en: It hasn't really worked.
zh: 它并没有真正奏效。

speaker: Unknown
en: And people have tried to direct list.
zh: 而且人们尝试过直接上市。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I've done two of them.
zh: 我做过两个。

speaker: Unknown
en: I know.
zh: 我知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: I've done two direct listings as well.
zh: 我也做过两个直接上市。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what I'm trying to tell you is, Dan, we need more options.
zh: 所以我想告诉你的是，Dan，我们需要更多选择。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you had more options, there would be less private capital.
zh: 如果你有更多选择，私人资本就会更少。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why?
zh: 为什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: It would make more sense to just underwrite them in the public market.
zh: 在公开市场承销它们会更有意义。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why?
zh: 为什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Because you can get in and get out.
zh: 因为你可以进退自如。

speaker: Unknown
en: You don't need to have a 15-year fund commitment.
zh: 你不需要有 15 年的资金承诺。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nobody would do that.
zh: 没有人会那样做。

speaker: Unknown
en: if you could buy Google at a $20 billion valuation and let it run.
zh: 如果你可以以 200 亿美元的估值购买 Google 并让它运行。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nobody would do that if you could have bought SpaceX at a $50 billion valuation and let it run.
zh: 如果你可以以 500 亿美元的估值购买 SpaceX 并让它运行，没有人会那样做。

speaker: Unknown
en: Or Anthropic or OpenAI at $50 billion versus a trillion.
zh: 或者以 500 亿美元购买 Anthropic 或 OpenAI 对比一万亿美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a very different exercise when you have a few companies going public and only a few.
zh: 当你有几家公司上市而且只有几家时，这是一个非常不同的练习。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I tried with the SPAC.
zh: 所以我尝试了 SPAC。

speaker: Unknown
en: It didn't work.
zh: 它没有奏效。

speaker: Unknown
en: Part of it was my incentives were misaligned.
zh: 部分原因是我激励措施错位了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I fixed the incentive part, but I'm going to keep banging on that door.
zh: 我修正了激励部分，但我打算继续敲那扇门。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, it's my side job because I have to run a company.
zh: 现在，这是我的副业，因为我必须经营一家公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you feel you have a lot, so much with this one?
zh: 你觉得你有很大，很多赌注压在这一件事上吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: I know you can't say there's a company.
zh: 我知道你不能说有一家公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: It sounds like there might be a company.
zh: 听起来好像可能有一家公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: Assuming this goes through, you buy it.
zh: 假设这事儿成了，你把它买下来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you personally, in terms of your credibility, reputation, feel you have a lot riding on this one succeeding, assuming one comes?
zh: 就个人而言，就你的信誉、声誉而言，你觉得假设真的有一个来的话，这一件的成功对你的声誉有很大的影响吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: More so than you did on others?
zh: 比你押在其他上面的更多吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Not a lot, but I have a deep responsibility to myself to fix what's broken.
zh: 不是很多，但我对自己有深深的责任去修复破损的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: I am an incredibly competitive person.
zh: 我是一个极具竞争力的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: I cannot describe to you, like, when I start something, I will perfect it until I win.
zh: 我无法向你描述，就像，当我开始一件事时，我会完善它直到我赢。

speaker: Unknown
en: That is a blemish on my track record, and I'm going to fix it.
zh: 那是我过往记录上的一个污点，我要把它修复好。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, we're having a 2026 conversation about 2021 facts.
zh: 就像，我们在进行一场 2026 年的对话，谈论的却是 2021 年的事实。

speaker: Unknown
en: Does that bother me?
zh: 那会困扰我吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Of course it does.
zh: 当然会。

speaker: Unknown
en: I want you to ask me about 80-90, but instead you're asking me about a SPAC.
zh: 我希望你问我关于 80-90 的事，但你却在问我关于一个 SPAC 的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's fine.
zh: 没关系。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, you have a new SPAC.
zh: 好吧，你有一个新的 SPAC。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wouldn't have asked you about SPACs.
zh: 我就不会问你关于 SPACs 的事了。

speaker: Unknown
en: No, but I'm just saying.
zh: 不，但我只是说说。

speaker: Unknown
en: I get it.
zh: 我懂了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I get it.
zh: 我懂了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's the desire to be good at something.
zh: 那是一种想把某事做好的渴望。

speaker: Unknown
en: I want to be a great allocator.
zh: 我想成为一个伟大的配置者。

speaker: Unknown
en: Capital, reputation, social influence, you know, time, people.
zh: 资本、声誉、社会影响力，你知道，时间、人员。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a basket of things.
zh: 这是一揽子事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm going to keep doing baskets of these things.
zh: 我打算继续做这一揽子的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I need to get it right.
zh: 所以我需要把它做对。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think if I get it right, many people will copy.
zh: 而且我认为如果我做对了，很多人会模仿。

speaker: Unknown
en: Look at the number of people that copied me the first time around.
zh: 看看第一回有多少人模仿我。

speaker: Unknown
en: Hold on.
zh: 等一下。

speaker: Unknown
en: It'll crack the door open for hundreds of companies to get financed.
zh: 这将为数百家公司获得融资敞开大门。

speaker: Unknown
en: Some of these guys will raise money to do some incredibly ambitious things and win.
zh: 这些人中有些会筹集资金去做一些非常有雄心的事情并获胜。

speaker: Unknown
en: My final question to you, speaking of that, we just had Father's Day.
zh: 我的最后一个问题给你，说到这个，我们刚过完父亲节。

speaker: Unknown
en: Can you tell me, this is why I want to end with, I think, what is one non-financial thing?
zh: 你能告诉我，这就是我想以此结束的原因，我想，有什么非金钱的东西吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: You talk about being competitive.
zh: 你谈到要有竞争力。

speaker: Unknown
en: What is one non-financial thing you hope your kids inherit from you?
zh: 有什么非金钱的东西是你希望你的孩子从你那里继承的？

speaker: Unknown
en: Nothing.
zh: 没有。

speaker: Unknown
en: want my kids to only know me as their dad.
zh: 希望我的孩子只知道我是他们的爸爸。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I want them to have a completely independent path in life.
zh: 而且我希望他们在生活中有一条完全独立的道路。

speaker: Unknown
en: To just do their things without any scepter.
zh: 只是做他们的事情，没有任何权杖。

speaker: Unknown
en: Not even a cent.
zh: 哪怕一分钱也没有。

speaker: Unknown
en: That it matters what he thinks.
zh: 即他的想法很重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: Zero.
zh: 零。

speaker: Unknown
en: Or that I want them to call me.
zh: 或者我希望他们给我打电话。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll tell you this.
zh: 我要告诉你这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm going to tell you this without...
zh: 我要不带...地告诉你这一点

speaker: Unknown
en: Getting emotional because I've told this story now four times.
zh: 情绪化，因为我现在讲这个故事已经讲四次了。

speaker: Unknown
en: My son is an intern.
zh: 我的儿子是一名实习生。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's 17 years old.
zh: 他 17 岁。

speaker: Unknown
en: At the White House Office of Presidential Correspondence.
zh: 在白宫总统通讯办公室。

speaker: Unknown
en: What does he do?
zh: 他做什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: He reads the mail.
zh: 他阅读邮件。

speaker: Unknown
en: He processes it.
zh: 他处理它。

speaker: Unknown
en: He helps.
zh: 他帮忙。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think maybe he helps write some drafts.
zh: 我想也许他帮忙写一些草稿。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm not totally sure, but for sure he processes.
zh: 我不完全确定，但肯定他处理。

speaker: Unknown
en: And Tuesdays from 1 to 2 p.m., he mans the presidential comment line, where people call in.
zh: 在星期二下午 1 点到 2 点，他负责总统评论热线，人们会打进来。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I had all these meetings stacked up on Tuesday, but it was very important for me to call.
zh: 我星期二堆了一堆会议，但对我来说打电话很重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I called, and I was the seventh person in line, sixth, fifth.
zh: 所以我打了电话，我是排队里的第七个人，第六，第五。

speaker: Unknown
en: I had to blow off one meeting, had to blow off another, and I just sat there on...
zh: 我不得不推掉一个会议，不得不推掉另一个，我就坐在那……

speaker: Unknown
en: And I finally got through.
zh: 我终于打通了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he said, you know, well, thank you for calling the presidential comment line.
zh: 他说，你知道，好吧，感谢拨打总统评论热线。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, may I take a comment for President Trump?
zh: 您知道，我可以为特朗普总统接收一条评论吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: And I just started crying.
zh: 我就开始哭。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he's like, hello?
zh: 他像是在说，喂？

speaker: Unknown
en: Hello?
zh: 喂？

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm like, oh, hey, Braden, it's your dad.
zh: 我说，噢，嘿，Braden，是你爸爸。

speaker: Unknown
en: I just want to say I'm really proud of President Trump.
zh: 我只是想说，我真的为特朗普总统感到骄傲。

speaker: Unknown
en: I love you.
zh: 我爱你。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I love the interns.
zh: 我爱那些实习生。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think, you know, just like a blathering kind of just I couldn't control myself.
zh: 我想，你知道，就像一种语无伦次，我无法控制我自己。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I want nothing from them.
zh: 所以我不从他们那里图任何东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: I selfishly want these little experiences where I can just be rooting for them.
zh: 我自私地想要这些小体验，让我只是为他们加油。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's the only thing that matters.
zh: 这是唯一重要的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's because none of us.
zh: 那是因为我们没有一个人。

speaker: Unknown
en: OK. We're all going to be dust.
zh: 好吧。我们都会成为尘土。

speaker: Unknown
en: None of it matters.
zh: 没有任何事重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you remember who the richest person in the world was in 1964?
zh: 你记得 1964 年世界首富是谁吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: I know you don't.
zh: 我知道你不记得。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wasn't alive then.
zh: 那时候我还没出生。

speaker: Unknown
en: OK.
zh: 好吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you remember who ran some really important thing in 1938 that was part of the American business lexicon?
zh: 你记得 1938 年谁掌管某个真正重要的东西，那是美国商业术语的一部分吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: No, you don't.
zh: 不，你不记得。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you remember who won the Academy Award in 1982 for supporting actor?
zh: 你记得 1982 年谁赢得了奥斯卡最佳男配角奖吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: No, you don't.
zh: 不，你不记得。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we're all just living this experience and we can all take it super seriously or we can try to find a way where we can actually live it for ourselves.
zh: 所以我们都在体验这种生活，我们都可以超级严肃地对待它，或者我们可以试着找到一种方式，让我们真正为自己而活。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I want my kids to live for themselves.
zh: 我希望我的孩子为自己而活。

speaker: Unknown
en: I want nothing where they think that they have to do something or did I inherit something from them or what about reputationally?
zh: 我不想要任何让他们觉得他们必须做什么，或者是我从他们那里继承了什么，或者是关于名声方面怎么样？

speaker: Unknown
en: No.
zh: 不。

speaker: Unknown
en: I want to be the guy that cheesily calls the comment line, starts crying.
zh: 我想要成为那个傻乎乎地打评论热线、开始哭泣的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then this weekend for Father's Day, ask me what I did.
zh: 然后这个父亲节周末，问问我做了什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: My son flew in from Washington.
zh: 我儿子从华盛顿飞过来了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We all flew in.
zh: 我们都飞过来了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And where did we go?
zh: 我们去了哪里？

speaker: Unknown
en: We all went to Las Vegas and we spent the weekend together.
zh: 我们都去了拉斯维加斯，我们在一起度过了周末。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was the best.
zh: 那是最好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Chamath, thanks so much for joining us.
zh: Chamath，非常感谢加入我们。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。

speaker: Unknown
en: Appreciate it.
zh: 多谢。
